versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 文旅项目机会诊断 (wenlv-opportunity-diagnosis) skill.
- Provides structured go/no-go diagnosis for cultural tourism projects, based on the "五维决策门 + 政策红线一票否决" framework.
- Strict sequential workflow: policy redline screening → five-dimension evaluation (resource, market, product, business, operation).
- Integrates mandatory information collection, redline compliance check, stepwise diagnostic questioning, and automatic structured report generation.
- Designed as an upstream filter—focuses on decision to proceed, not detailed project execution.
